ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text:
Ten kangaroos stood in a line as shown in the diagram.
<image1>
At a particular moment, two kangaroos standing nose-to-nose exchanged places by jumping past each other. Each of the two kangaroos involved in an exchange continued to face the same way as it did before the exchange. This was repeated until no further exchanges were possible. How many exchanges were made?

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: Observing the orientations of these 10 kangaroos from the attached figure from left to right, they are in order: facing right, facing right, facing right, facing left, facing left, facing right, facing right, facing right, facing left, facing left. That is, the direction sequence is R, R, R, L, L, R, R, R, L, L. Reasoning: Two kangaroos will exchange positions only when they are adjacent and “nose to nose,” which corresponds to a right-facing kangaroo R being on the left of a left-facing kangaroo L and adjacent, that is, forming adjacent RL. After exchanging, the two kangaroos still maintain their original orientations, so the whole process is equivalent to continuously exchanging RL in the sequence into LR. Every pair of kangaroos with “initially R on the left and L on the right” will eventually meet and exchange once; other combinations will not exchange. Therefore the total number of exchanges equals the number of R-L inversion pairs in the initial sequence. Counting these pairs: For the two left-facing kangaroos in positions 4 and 5, each has 3 right-facing kangaroos on its left, contributing 3+3. For the two left-facing kangaroos in positions 9 and 10, each has 6 right-facing kangaroos on its left, contributing 6+6. The total number of exchanges is 3+3+6+6=18.

raw_record.question_text: Ten kangaroos stood in a line as shown in the diagram. At a particular moment, two kangaroos standing nose-to-nose exchanged places by jumping past each other. Each of the two kangaroos involved in an exchange continued to face the same way as it did before the exchange. This was repeated until no further exchanges were possible. How many exchanges were made?

method.method_draft: First inspect the line of kangaroos in the image from left to right and record each facing direction: right, right, right, left, left, right, right, right, left, left. From the text, an exchange can occur exactly when an adjacent right-facing kangaroo is immediately to the left of a left-facing kangaroo, i.e. they are nose-to-nose, and after swapping they keep their directions. Use the inversion-count rule: each right-facing/left-facing pair with the right-facing kangaroo initially to the left of the left-facing kangaroo will meet and exchange exactly once, and no other pair exchanges. Count these pairs from the visual sequence: the two left-facing kangaroos in positions 4 and 5 each have 3 right-facing kangaroos before them, and the two left-facing kangaroos in positions 9 and 10 each have 6 right-facing kangaroos before them. Total exchanges = 3+3+6+6 = 18.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：从附图中按从左到右观察这 10 只袋鼠的朝向，依次是：向右、向右、向右、向左、向左、向右、向右、向右、向左、向左。也就是方向序列为 R, R, R, L, L, R, R, R, L, L。

推理：两只袋鼠只有在相邻且“鼻子对鼻子”时才会交换位置，这对应于一个向右的袋鼠 R 在一个向左的袋鼠 L 的左边并且相邻，即形成相邻的 RL。交换后两只袋鼠仍保持原朝向，所以整个过程等价于不断把序列中的 RL 交换成 LR。每一对“初始时 R 在左、L 在右”的袋鼠最终会相遇并交换一次；其他组合不会交换。因此交换总数等于初始序列中 R-L 逆序对的数量。

数这些对：第 4、5 位的两只向左袋鼠，每只左边都有 3 只向右袋鼠，贡献 3+3。第 9、10 位的两只向左袋鼠，每只左边都有 6 只向右袋鼠，贡献 6+6。总交换数为 3+3+6+6=18。

planner_metadata.text_role: Use the rule that only adjacent nose-to-nose kangaroos swap, and that their facing directions remain unchanged after each swap, repeated until no swaps are possible.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: Bridge the process to inversion counting: adjacent swaps of R before L continue until all L's are to the left of all R's, and the number of swaps equals the number of initial R-L inversions.
